hints.title: Square Bound Range Bisection
hints.text: The components a and b satisfy a^2 + b^2 = c. The search range for each component is bounded between 0 and floor(sqrt(c)).

hints.title: Inward Pointer Convergence
hints.text: Initialize left at 0 and right at floor(sqrt(c)). Compare left^2 + right^2 against c.

hints.title: Monotonic Adjustment Loop
hints.text: If sum equals c, return true. If sum is less than c, increment left; if sum is greater than c, decrement right. If pointers cross, return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(sqrt(C)) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs (a, b) takes quadratic O(C) operations, which times out when C reaches 2^31 - 1.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual-pointer convergence shrinks the search space monotonically in O(sqrt(C)) steps with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid 32-bit integer overflow when calculating left*left + right*right.
